subjects.description: Machined metal workpieces ({parts}) lying on a workbench next to a CNC machining centre
subjects.appearance_details: Real machined parts: milled and turned aluminium and steel with fine tool marks, slightly dull edges, a thin film of cutting fluid on some surfaces, small burrs and light scratches, a few anodized or painted parts
subjects.relationship: Finished parts waiting to be loaded into the machine by a robot
subjects.pose: Resting flat on the bench in stable positions
subjects.action: Static, nothing moves except the camera

background_setting: A working CNC machine shop: a steel workbench with a worn grey or dark rubber surface, metal chips and faint oil stains, the sliding door and control panel of a machining centre nearby, tool trolleys, a concrete floor with yellow safety tape

lighting.conditions: Bright industrial LED high-bay lighting, neutral white, slightly uneven
lighting.shadows: Soft contact shadows under each part, small specular highlights on machined metal

aesthetics.composition: Functional view of the bench with every part visible
aesthetics.color_scheme: Natural industrial greys and metal tones with occasional colored anodized parts

cinematography.camera_motion: Slow, smooth handheld-free camera move around the bench, like an industrial camera on a slowly moving robot arm
cinematography.framing: Close to medium shot of the bench top with all parts in frame
cinematography.camera_angle: High angle looking down at the bench
cinematography.depth_of_field: Deep focus, all parts sharp as with a machine-vision camera
cinematography.lens_focal_length: Machine-vision lens, natural perspective, slight vignetting

style_medium: Raw footage from a real industrial camera, unedited, no color grading
artistic_style: Photorealistic, authentic real-world recording: real materials, natural light falloff, faint sensor noise, accurate colors, ordinary signs of use
context: Footage from a robotic machine tending cell in a small high-tech manufacturing company
